item.description: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Friday, May 15th, 2026! It’s a mainly clear start to your day here in Sydney, currently sitting at a crisp 15°C, feeling exactly as it is. While the temperature is set to climb to a mild 19°C, there’s an 84% chance of rain, so definitely grab that brolly before you head out! As you dive into your Daily Drive, remember that every new day is a blank canvas, full of possibilities waiting for your unique brushstrokes. Here's to making today count and having an absolutely brilliant day!
